sentences.text: The Marbled White is an insect in the order Lepidoptera.
In Mainz-Bingen, 644 reports were recorded over ten years, with the main time running from June to July.
It has been recorded eating Red Clover, field scabious, and Festuca rubra.
Common Wall Lizard and Flower Spider are recorded as predators.
Pollination has been recorded at Carthusian Pink, Small Scabious, field scabious, and zigzag clover, among others.
